name: 4 Seater Outdoor Lounge Set
material: 2*1 teslin fabrics, steel frame w/t powder coated/heat transfer armrest. w/t yarn-dyed fabric cushion. Coffee table w/t 5mm black silk screen printing glass
description: The Sunburst Outdoor Lounge Set brings breezy contemporary style to your outdoor space. With its clean-lined frames, deep cushioning, and airy negative space, the seating design feels both grounded and light. The glass-topped metal coffee table is the centrepiece, making it the perfect set for relaxed entertaining or laid-back afternoons in the sun.
